title: Annual water tank cleaning — Block B
body: Water supply to Block B will be suspended between 10 AM and 2 PM while the overhead tank is cleaned.

title: Independence Day flag hoisting
body: Flag hoisting at the central lawn at 8 AM, followed by breakfast hosted by the committee.

title: AGM scheduled for September
body: The Annual General Meeting will be held in the clubhouse. Agenda to follow by email.

title: New visitor gate policy from Gate 1
body: All visitors must be pre-approved through the resident app before entry starting this week.
